assumption_tested: does a DEDICATED, engine-native pySigma backend preserve the event_count window where the generic path dropped it?
benchmark: ocsf-sigma-detection / ClickHouse execution (H-SIGMA-01 lakehouse leg, backend 4 — DEDICATED backend)
compile_path: DEDICATED pySigma ClickHouse backend (ClickhouseBackend) — engine-native (emits uniqExact for value_count)

correlation_coverage.temporal_sql: SELECT actor_user, arrayStringConcat(groupArray(sigma_rule_id), ',') AS rule_sequence, uniqExact(sigma_rule_id) AS rule_count, min(timestamp) AS first_event, max(timestamp) AS last_event FROM (SELECT *, 'a' AS sigma_rule_id FROM logs WHERE outcome='FAILURE' UNION ALL SELECT *, 'b' AS sigma_rule_id FROM logs WHERE outcome='SUCCESS') AS subquery GROUP BY actor_user HAVING rule_count >= 2 AND toUnixTimestamp(last_event) - toUnixTimestamp(first_event) <= 600
correlation_coverage.value_count_sql: SELECT src_ip, uniqExact(actor_user) AS value_count FROM (SELECT * FROM logs WHERE outcome='FAILURE') AS subquery GROUP BY src_ip HAVING value_count >= 10

event_count.correct_windowed_sql: SELECT actor_user FROM (SELECT actor_user, count(*) c FROM logs WHERE outcome='FAILURE' GROUP BY actor_user, intDiv(timestamp, 600) HAVING c >= 10) GROUP BY actor_user
event_count.emitted_sql: SELECT actor_user, count(*) AS event_count FROM (SELECT * FROM logs WHERE outcome='FAILURE') AS subquery GROUP BY actor_user HAVING event_count >= 10

evidence_tier: B (single host; synthetic planted corpus; ClickHouse + DEDICATED pySigma-backend-clickhouse 1.0.0)
three_band: SILENTLY-DEGRADES (windowless emit + over-fire from a DEDICATED backend despite engine capability)
